verdict.rationale: Honeycomb Triggers and SLO burn alerts let users define threshold rules that automatically fire actions. These actions route to Slack, PagerDuty, Teams, or custom webhooks, and webhook payloads can be customized with variables and Go templates. Triggers can also be managed programmatically via the API. Missing for 10: native actions beyond notifications/webhooks (e.g., built-in remediation or workflow steps), rules on individual events rather than aggregate query thresholds, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
